verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's own registered-agent docs name a Compliance Calendar that sends email reminders about annual report deadlines, and promise reminders as those deadlines approach. A real-time compliance-status notification adds to this. Missing for 10: evidence that the calendar covers filing deadlines beyond annual reports, detail on the calendar view or reminder lead times, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can see a compliance calendar of upcoming filing deadlines and get reminders before each one

citations.quote: Email reminders about annual report deadlines through the Compliance Calendar
get reminders when annual report deadlines are approaching
Real-time notifications about your compliance status, upon receipt of data from your state filing office
